about: A series' seasons on its title page: whether a season has a mark of its own (« Marquer la saison comme vue »: only beside another season), what it marks (the season as Jellyfin holds it, else each episode) and whether all its episodes are watched; and the season of the episode Lecture plays when another is shown (« À suivre »). Read by tests/Mira.Core.Tests (EpisodePages) and tools/web/unit (seasons.js): both must agree. cases: [name, episodes (Id, SeasonId, season, played; season null = none, read as 1), marks, [[season, ids, played]], next: [[season shown, next episode, season of « À suivre » or null]]]
cases: one season: the series' own button marks it
no season of Jellyfin's (an anime numbered without seasons): each episode
a season split between two of Jellyfin's: each episode
